body.zh: 随着“一国党”的日益受欢迎，工党对这个国家最富有州的控制即将受到考验，这使得其安全席位受到质疑。 长期任职的国会议员兼高级政府部长保罗·帕帕利亚(Paul Papalia)中期退休引发州补选，珀斯南部秘密港海滨席位的选民将于周六前往投票站。 政治分析家约翰·菲利摩尔 (John Phillimore) 告诉澳联社：“这一势头似乎属于一国党。” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 但问题可能出在细节上，最近的一项调查显示，西澳大利亚州初选选票中工党的支持率稳定在 33%。 自 6 月以来，一国党的支持率上升了 3%，与自由党持平，得票率为 21%。 科廷大学约翰·科廷公共政策研究所执行主任菲利莫尔表示：“一国党的支持率并不像该国其他地区那么高，因此提前宣布这一计划必须要谨慎。” “出于同样的原因，在补选中，政府总是会大力反对。” 西澳州长罗杰·库克承认，尽管工党的优势率为 11.5%，但争夺远郊抵押贷款带席位将是一场战斗。 “目前，你会看到东海岸‘一国党’的受欢迎程度激增，”他周五告诉记者。 库克还很快指出，他的政府在2025年州选举中赢得了下议院59个席位中的46个席位，这对选举结果影响不大，这是该党连续第三次取得压倒性胜利。 One Nation 在贸易天堂 Secret Harbor 的表演将引起全国的关注，尤其是维多利亚州，该州将于 11 月举行州选举。 这可能会对高级联邦自由党议员安德鲁·哈斯蒂(Andrew Hastie)产生更长期的影响，他在坎宁的边缘席位占据了秘密港选民的席位，并且正成为一国党的公开攻击目标。 哈斯蒂被认为是未来的自由党领袖，他誓言要捍卫去年以 6.5% 的优势保住的席位。 预计一国党将很快在下届联邦选举中宣布坎宁的候选人。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

summary.en: Long-held expectations about life in public are being quietly rewritten, experts warn.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Artificial intelligence is increasingly used by police departments across Australia, with experts warning that lines must be drawn over the technology's use, invoking the dystopian world depicted in George Orwell's novel Nineteen Eighty-Four as a potential future to avoid.

Police departments are starting to trial the use of AI technology for "various forms of surveillance" and "predictive policing", professor Toby Walsh, chief scientist at the UNSW AI Institute, told SBS News.

In WA, police have been trialling AI facial recognition software to scan pedestrians on the street and compare their faces against watchlists. In the trial's first week, 130,000 people were scanned, leading to 18 arrests.

Walsh said that while most people would be "pleased" with the result, he believes such public surveillance is "an erosion of the things that we used to value".

"The question is, how much are we willing to trade those values for the benefits that the technology is bringing?"

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Overseas, the rise of AI in surveillance technology has become an increasingly contested topic.

In the United States, citizens have been taking action against the surveillance cameras of the AI company Flock Safety, which has tens of thousands of devices across the country. Videos of people destroying the cameras have gone viral on social media.

Tom Sulston, head of policy at the advocacy group Digital Rights Watch, told SBS News that, while Flock cameras are not currently used outside of the US, "plenty" of companies in Australia are doing "similar things".

Palantir, the US data analytics firm contracted by military and US immigration forces, and Cellebrite, an Israeli digital forensics company working with law enforcement, both have tens of millions of dollars in government and private contracts in Australia.

"We should be concerned," Sulston said. "We have a right to go out in public without being surveilled, without having our biometric data uploaded to the cloud, and without it being used for purposes we don't really know."

Both have said that governments across the country need to rapidly turn their focus to expanding individual privacy laws, particularly as wearable surveillance technology like smart glasses become more widespread.

"We do have some legislation that covers public surveillance, but the more companies that get into that market, the more pressure there will be to relax them," Sulston said.

Walsh argues that a line between privacy and security "has to be drawn" as AI has made previously impossible levels of surveillance mundane.

summary.en: As more Australians become homeowners later in life, what happens when a mortgage long outlasts your working life?
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Share your feedback and help us improve this feature. Read more about how we use AI at SBS here.

The 52-year-old bought his first home about a decade ago and refinanced it in 2024, locking in a new 30-year loan term just before he turned 50.

He's among a growing cohort of Australians buying their first home later in life. People over the age of 40 accounted for nearly one in five first-home buyers last year (18.7 per cent), according to data from one of Australia's largest mortgage brokers, Aussie Home Loans.

At the other end, people under the age of 20 made up around a quarter of first-home buyers in 2005, compared with less than 0.5 per cent in 2025.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

As housing affordability pressures make it harder for young Australians to enter the market, solutions designed to ease the path to home ownership have increasingly focused on expanding access to credit — allowing buyers to borrow more, with smaller deposits or longer mortgage terms.

Low-deposit loans can be accessed through the federal government's 5 per cent deposit scheme , while family guarantor loans allow first-time buyers to borrow up to 100 per cent of the purchase price.

Meanwhile, more lenders are offering 40-year mortgage terms , meaning some borrowers could be signing up to make repayments well into their later years.

If a growing number of Australians are buying homes later while taking on larger loans for longer, what happens when they reach retirement still saddled with mortgage debt?

According to James Graham, a housing economics expert at the University of Sydney, without massively expanding housing supply, broadening access to credit alone is not a sustainable solution.

When the government introduced its 5 per cent deposit scheme last year, designed to help first-home buyers, the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) predicted the measure would likely "put at least some further upward pressure" on housing price growth.

By March, the value of new loans taken out by first-home buyers was around 11 per cent higher than before the scheme was expanded in October, with the increase largely reflecting bigger average loan sizes, according to the RBA.

Graham says buying a first home later in life could have consequences beyond carrying mortgage debt into retirement. Entering the market at 40 or 50 leaves less time to build housing wealth and can reduce people's ability to move as their lives change.

"People are likely to be locked in for longer," he explains, warning that some buyers may end up remaining in homes that were intended as a first step into the market rather than a last stop.

summary.en: Sexual violence is rising amongst young Australians. This consent educator thinks curiosity is a potential solution.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article contains references to child sexual abuse and sexual assault.

The death of a 16-year-old girl after a suspected sexual strangulation act has unearthed major concerns about the increasing rate of young people experiencing and perpetrating sexual violence.

Consent educator Sarnia Ralston told SBS News that sexual strangulation is "not a freak occurrence" in young people's sexual experiences.

"We need young people to know that sexual strangulation is not something that you can ever do safely," she said.

"The exposure to online pornography has a direct correlation to young people's expectations of sex."

The girl's death comes days after three students were charged with the sexual assault of a 14-year-old girl in Bondi, and three boys were charged with the sexual assault of a 17-year-old girl in Sydney's McCarthur region.

"Escalating rates of sexual violence, particularly amongst young people, are a huge concern that we need to address," Social Services Minister Tanya Plibersek said in parliament.

"Almost 40 per cent of victims of sexual assault are between the ages of 10 and 17, and we know that online harms are spilling into real-life harm."

Plibersek said "sexual strangulation is becoming more commonplace" due to children being exposed to "violent and degrading pornography".

According to the Breathless Campaign, 57 per cent of young Australians have been strangled by a partner during sex and 51 per cent have strangled a partner during sex.

Ralston is the Queensland and Northern Territory projects executive manager and facilitator trainer for a primary prevention program called Love Bites.

Operated by the National Association for Prevention of Child Abuse and Neglect, Love Bites is a trauma-informed and evidence-based respectful relationships program teaching young people across Australia since 2003.

A national network of grassroots facilitators delivers it to young people aged 11 to 17.

Designed in line with Australia’s consent curriculum, it’s "scaffolded according to their developmental needs" and addresses topics like consent, technology-facilitated abuse, pornography and coercive control.

"It's a universal program that really challenges the drivers of violence ... we unpack what the attitudes and beliefs are that form somebody’s actions or behaviours," said Ralston.

In 2022, almost 40 per cent of young people had already encountered online pornography by the age of 13.

Ralston said pornography and its effects are so pervasive that the Love Bites senior program is now being delivered to the youngest cohort.

body.en: She’s written two books, launched a progressive media firm and plans to dethrone the prime minister – all before she turns 30. What is she about? Hannah Ferguson has just left the home of an older couple who disagree that she should run for parliament when I meet her at the Lewisham West light rail stop on the Greenway in Sydney’s inner-west. It is a perfect sunny winter afternoon and we are in the geographical centre of Grayndler, the electorate she wants to take from the prime minister , Anthony Albanese. The couple emailed Ferguson after she announced her plans to run, declaring, she says, that they liked her but didn’t agree with her tilt for parliament. She tells me she asked to sit down with them and explain herself, and believes they’ve come around to the idea of her running – and might even support her. Continue reading...

title.en: This Australian crisis is entering a 'confronting' new phase

summary.en: Older Australians accounted for more than half of the fatalities in a record high of drug-induced deaths, with 2,596 deaths documented in 2024, 80.5 percent of which were from unintentional overdose. Since 2008, drug-induced deaths have surpassed road fatalities.
summary.zh: 根据2024年记录的2596例药物致死事件，其中80.5%为意外过量，老年澳大利亚人占了死亡人数的一半以上，创下药物致死新高。自2008年以来，药物致死人数已超过道路交通事故死亡人数。

body.en:
This article contains references to substance abuse and suicide.

Drug-induced deaths have hit a record high, with older Australians accounting for more than half of the fatalities.

Australia's Annual Overdose Report, released by the Penington Institute, documented 2,596 drug-induced deaths in 2024, with 80.5 per cent being from unintentional overdose.

Since 2008, more Australians have died from drug-induced deaths than road fatalities — with an average of 31 years lost per death.

"The data is quite confronting," Jake Dizard, director of research at the Penington Institute, told SBS News.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The report found that the median age of people dying from drug overdose is increasing.

For the first time, those aged between 50 and 59 accounted for almost half of all unintentional overdose deaths.

Dizard said it could be attributed to "an ageing large cohort of people who started using drugs in the 1990s and early 2000s".

"As that cohort has got older, they have become more vulnerable to drug-induced death because of the length of time that they have been using drugs and the accumulating sort of comorbidities," he said.

The report also noted that of the 428 drug-induced suicides, 39 per cent were people aged 60 and over.

Australian Alcohol and Other Drugs Council CEO Melanie Walker said the report confirms that overdose is not a "young people problem".

"It affects young people. It also affects older people. Overdose can be from illicit drug use, or it can be from prescription drug use."

The report also found that men accounted for 72.7 per cent of unintentional drug-induced deaths, people living in regional and rural areas had higher rates of death than those living in capital cities, and Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people experienced higher rates of overdose.

In 2024, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people experienced an overdose rate of 29.3 per 100,000 compared to 6.6 per 100,000 for non-Indigenous people.

Opioids were responsible for 42 per cent of all drug-induced deaths in 2024, with heroin-related deaths rising from 101 deaths in 2001 to 488 deaths in 2024.

Amphetamines were involved in 772 deaths, a record high for the drug, and cocaine was involved in 141 deaths. Benzodiazepines, alcohol and antidepressants also contributed to drug-induced deaths.

Dizard said that the use of prescription opioids, such as oxycodone, has declined since 2021 — a trend seen across "a number of categories of prescription drugs".

Cocaine was the only recorded drug that saw a decrease in the median age of people dying from overdose.

title.en: Exclusive: Memo reveals why NT Police were not charged over this death in custody
title.zh: 独家：备忘录揭示了为何北领地警方未因这起狱中死亡事件被起诉

summary.en: Documents obtained by SBS News offer new insight into the police response to the death in custody of Kumanjayi White, a 24-year-old Warlpiri man who died after being restrained by officers in a supermarket. His death sparked nationwide protests and calls for an independent investigation from his family.
summary.zh: SBS新闻获得的解密文件揭示了警方对库曼贾伊·怀特（Kumanjayi White）狱中死亡事件的应对措施。这位24岁的瓦尔皮里族男子在一家超市被警官制服后死亡。他的死亡事件引发了全国范围的抗议，家属呼吁进行独立调查。

body.en:
SBS News can reveal Northern Territory Police waited four months to send the NT's Director of Public Prosecutions (NTDPP) an 'opinion file' seeking advice after the death in custody of a 24-year-old Warlpiri man.

Known as Kumanjayi White for cultural reasons, the young man who also lived with disabilities died in May last year after he was restrained by two plain-clothes police officers in the confectionery aisle of an Alice Springs supermarket.

His death sparked nationwide protests over government inaction on Aboriginal deaths in custody, with protesters echoing calls by his family for an independent investigation.

White's family launched legal action against NT Police after it was announced the two officers involved would not be prosecuted in May — but discontinued the action earlier this month.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Now, an internal memo obtained by SBS News via a Freedom of Information (FOI) request offers an insight into the reasoning behind the NTDPP's decision not to prosecute.

The email obtained through FOI is dated 26 May 2026 and was sent by the then acting director of the NTDPP Patrick Williams to all NTDPP staff announcing the news that no charges would be laid over White's death.

"Shortly following your receipt of this email, it will become public knowledge that I have determined there are no reasonable prospects of securing a conviction on any charge arising out of his death on the basis of the evidence provided by police," Williams writes in the memo.

"For that reason, I have met with them on country this morning to inform them of the view that I have reached."

Williams goes on to explain the decision, noting that the department "may be the subject of some media criticism" as a result.

"That criticism may include questioning the integrity and independence of our office, noting the relationship between the NTDPP and NT Police Force," he writes.

It notes that a police opinion file was delivered in September 2025, four months after White's death.

At that time, acting NT police commissioner Martin Dole told media that investigators had "compiled a full and comprehensive brief of evidence".

But the internal memo obtained by SBS News reveals prosecutors had asked police to obtain an additional independent report into the use of force in White's arrest "within days" of receiving the opinion file in September.

It was later revealed by Dole that this 'use of force' report was conducted by Queensland Police.

The email also shows Williams sought advice from external interstate senior and junior counsel on whether the evidence provided by police was sufficient to warrant prosecution.

Following news of White's...
body.zh: SBS 新闻透露，在一名 24 岁瓦尔皮里男子在拘留期间死亡后，北领地警方等了四个月才向北领地检察长 (NTDPP) 发送一份寻求建议的“意见文件”。 由于文化原因，这名年轻人被称为库曼贾伊·怀特 (Kumanjayi White)，他也是一名残疾人，去年 5 月在爱丽丝泉超市的糖果过道里被两名便衣警察制服后死亡。 他的死亡引发了全国范围内的抗议活动，抗议政府对拘留中的原住民死亡事件不采取行动，抗议者响应他的家人要求进行独立调查的呼吁。 怀特的家人在五月宣布两名涉案警官不会被起诉后，对北领地警方发起了法律诉讼，但本月早些时候停止了这一行动。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 现在，SBS 新闻通过信息自由 (FOI) 请求获得的一份内部备忘录提供了对 NTDPP 决定不起诉背后原因的深入了解。 通过信息自由获得的电子邮件日期为 2026 年 5 月 26 日，由时任 NTDPP 代理主任帕特里克·威廉姆斯 (Patrick Williams) 发送给所有 NTDPP 工作人员，宣布不会对怀特之死提出任何指控。 威廉姆斯在备忘录中写道：“在您收到这封电子邮件后不久，公众就会知道，我已经确定，根据警方提供的证据，对因他的死亡而产生的任何指控都没有合理的定罪前景。” “出于这个原因，我今天早上在乡村会见了他们，告诉他们我所达成的观点。” 威廉姆斯接着解释了这一决定，并指出该部门因此“可能成为一些媒体批评的对象”。 他写道：“这种批评可能包括质疑我们办公室的完整性和独立性，并指出 NTDPP 和北领地警察部队之间的关系。” 它指出，警方的意见文件于 2025 年 9 月提交，即怀特去世四个月后。 当时，北领地代理警察局长马丁·多尔（Martin Dole）告诉媒体，调查人员已经“编制了一份完整且全面的证据简介”。 但 SBS​​ 新闻获得的内部备忘录显示，检察官已要求警方在 9 月份收到意见文件后“几天内”就逮捕怀特时使用武力的情况获取一份额外的独立报告。 多尔后来透露，这份“使用武力”报告是由昆士兰警方进行的。 该电子邮件还显示，威廉姆斯就警方提供的证据是否足以起诉，向外部州际高级和初级律师寻求建议。 继怀特的消息...

reflection.en: The death of Kumanjayi White and the subsequent protests underscore a deep yearning for justice and accountability. The call for an independent investigation echoes the ancient prophetic cry for justice to be a powerful, unstoppable force, like a mighty river flowing through the land. May this pursuit lead to healing and true resolution for all involved.
reflection.zh: 库曼贾伊·怀特的死亡以及随后的抗议活动，凸显了人们对公正和问责的深切渴望。要求进行独立调查的呼声，呼应了古代先知们关于公正如江河般奔腾不息的呼喊。愿这一追求能为所有相关方带来医治和真正的解决。

title.en: A teenager's death has prompted fresh calls for relationship education
title.zh: 少女之死引发关于关系教育的新呼吁

summary.en: The death of a 16-year-old girl, found unresponsive at a Sydney home and later dying in hospital, has led to prominent calls for expanded relationship education, with reports suggesting sexual choking as a possible factor.
summary.zh: 一名16岁的少女在悉尼一处住宅被发现时没有反应，后在医院不治身亡。据报道，死因可能与性窒息有关，这一悲剧引发了公众对扩大关系教育的呼吁。

body.en:
A teenage girl's tragic death, which has been reported as being linked to sexual choking, has sparked high-profile calls for broadened relationship education.

A 16-year-old girl was found unresponsive at an Elanora Heights home, on Sydney's Northern Beaches, on Sunday.

Police declined to confirm reports detectives were investigating sexual choking as a possible factor in the death.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Independent MP Zali Steggall mentioned the reports after a National Cabinet meeting on Wednesday affirmed a commitment to ending gender-based violence.

She said agreed measures were weak and pushed for more action, including a respectful relationship education campaign.

"My call for a national education campaign has been underscored by the devastating news today of the death of a 16-year-old Northern Beaches girl," Steggall said in a statement.

"My thoughts are with her family, friends and community at this incredibly difficult time."

Social Services Minister Tanya Plibersek said there was no safe way to engage in choking.

"I'm sure I've said it to you in the past almost 60 per cent of young people report they've experienced choking in a recent sexual encounter," she told ABC Radio on Thursday morning.

"I can't say anything, obviously, about this tragic situation in NSW ... but in general terms, figures like that just concern me so deeply.

"There is no safe way of choking someone. Parents have to use this opportunity to talk to their young people."

A survey of 4702 Australians between 18 and 35 in 2024 found 57 per cent of respondents had been choked during sex at least once.

One-third of those respondents reported it occurring for the first time between 19 and 21.

The report's co-author noted choking in a sexual context could lead to serious brain injuries, including memory loss and issues with problem-solving.

"It doesn't matter if there are no apparent injuries, or whether the person consented," Professor Heather Douglas said at the time.

"Brain injury can also be incremental — getting a bit worse with each choking — and the person may not know they have suffered a brain injury. The effects of repeated strangling are insidious and build over time."

For the latest from SBS News, download our app and subscribe to our newsletter .
body.zh: 据报道，一名少女的惨死与性窒息有关，这引发了人们对扩大关系教育的高调呼吁。 周日，一名 16 岁女孩被发现在悉尼北部海滩埃拉诺拉高地 (Elanora Heights) 的一处家中失去知觉。 警方拒绝证实侦探正在调查性窒息可能是死亡原因的报道。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 独立议员扎利·斯特格尔在周三的国家内阁会议确认了结束性别暴力的承诺后提到了这些报告。 她表示商定的措施很薄弱，并敦促采取更多行动，包括开展相互尊重的关系教育活动。 斯特格尔在一份声明中说：“今天一名 16 岁北部海滩女孩死亡的毁灭性消息凸显了我对全国教育运动的呼吁。” “在这个极其困难的时刻，我的心与她的家人、朋友和社区同在。” 社会服务部长塔尼娅·普利伯塞克 (Tanya Plibersek) 表示，没有安全的方法可以让孩子窒息。 “我确信我过去曾对你说过，近 60% 的年轻人表示他们在最近的性接触中经历过窒息，”她周四早上告诉 ABC 电台。 “显然，对于新南威尔士州的这一悲惨局势，我无法说什么……但总的来说，这样的数字让我深感担忧。 “没有安全的方法可以让某人窒息。父母必须利用这个机会与年轻人交谈。” 2024 年对 4702 名 18 岁至 35 岁的澳大利亚人进行的一项调查发现，57% 的受访者在性行为中至少被窒息过一次。 三分之一的受访者表示第一次发生这种情况是在 19 岁至 21 岁之间。 该报告的合著者指出，在性行为中窒息可能会导致严重的脑损伤，包括记忆丧失和解决问题的问题。 希瑟·道格拉斯教授当时表示：“是否没有明显的伤害，或者当事人是否同意，这并不重要。” “脑损伤也可能是渐进的——每次窒息都会变得更严重——而且患者可能不知道自己已经遭受了脑损伤。反复勒死的影响是阴险的，并且会随着时间的推移而增强。” 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: The tragic death of a 16-year-old girl, reportedly linked to dangerous sexual practices, underscores a profound societal failure in equipping young people with knowledge about healthy relationships and consent. This incident serves as a stark reminder of the vulnerability of youth and the critical need for comprehensive education that can prevent such...
reflection.zh: 一名16岁少女的悲惨死亡，据报道与危险的性行为有关，这凸显了社会在向年轻人传授健康关系和知情同意知识方面的严重不足。这一事件令人痛心地提醒我们年轻人的脆弱性，以及全面教育对于防止此类毁灭性后果的紧迫性，这与先知呼吁为受压迫者辩护、为弱势群体发声的精神不谋而合。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: Hong Kong court acquits police officer of indecent assault charge after accuser’s testimony rejected
title.zh: 原告证词被驳回后，香港法院宣判警员非礼罪名不成立

summary.en: A Hong Kong court has found a police officer not guilty of indecent assault after rejecting the testimony of his accuser. Officer Ng Ka‑wai pleaded not guilty when he appeared at the Kowloon City Magistrates’ Courts on Friday. According to the case details, the 41-year-old...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: A Hong Kong court has found a police officer not guilty of indecent assault after rejecting the testimony of his accuser. Hong Kong Police Force. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Officer Ng Ka‑wai pleaded not guilty when he appeared at the Kowloon City Magistrates’ Courts on Friday. According to the case details, the 41-year-old allegedly touched the thigh of a female informant and opened a nude photo of her without her consent inside Tsim Sha Tsui Police Station on December 20 last year. The informant was in the station to report being blackmailed with nude photos and defrauded of HK$1.6 million. Police then arranged for Ng to assist the informant in giving a statement. According to the prosecution, the informant told Ng that a fraudster had sent her nude photos of herself using the “View Once” feature on WhatsApp to blackmail her. She then handed her phone to Ng, who she alleged opened one of the photos without her permission. She also alleged that Ng asked her to stand with him to check online bank statements, and then touched her thigh three times. Kowloon City Magistrates’ Courts. Photo: Candice Chau/HKFP. However, Magistrate Arthur Lam said on Friday that what the woman told the court was not consistent with her written statements. For example, the woman told the court that she only realised a suspected “View Once” nude photo had been opened after getting her phone back from the defendant. But during cross-examination, the defence cited her written statement, in which she said that the defendant showed her the nude photos on her mobile and commented on them while viewing them. 💡 If you are suffering from sexual or domestic violence, regardless of your age or gender, contact the police, Harmony House ( click for details ) and/or the Social Welfare Department on 28948896. Dial 999 in emergencies. Lam called the informant’s explanations unconvincing, and the court therefore did not accept her testimony. He ruled that Ng was not guilty of the charge and awarded him legal costs. A conviction for indecent assault in Hong Kong carries a maximum penalty of 10 years’ imprisonment.
body.zh: 香港一家法院在驳回原告的证词后，裁定一名警察无猥亵罪。香港警队。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。警员吴家伟周五在九龙城裁判法院出庭时表示不认罪。案件详情显示，41岁男子涉嫌于去年12月20日在尖沙咀警署内，未经女线人同意，触摸一名女线人的大腿，并打开其裸照。举报人在车站举报遭裸照敲诈，并被骗港币160万元。警方其后安排吴协助举报人供述。据检方称，线人告诉吴某，一名诈骗者利用 WhatsApp 上的“查看一次”功能向她发送了自己的裸照，以勒索她。然后她把手机交给了吴女士，她声称吴女士未经她的许可就打开了其中一张照片。她还声称，吴让她和他站在一起查看网上银行对账单，然后摸了她的大腿三下。九龙城裁判法院。照片：Candice Chau/HKFP。然而，裁判官林亚瑟周五表示，该女子在法庭上所说的与她的书面陈述不一致。例如，该女子告诉法庭，她从被告手中拿回手机后才发现一张疑似“查看一次”的裸照被打开。但在盘问中，辩方引用了她的书面陈述，称被告向她展示了手机上的裸照，并在观看时发表了评论。 💡 如果您遭受性暴力或家庭暴力，无论您的年龄或性别，请与警方、和谐之家（点击查看详情）和/或社会福利署联系：28948896。紧急情况请拨打999。林郑月娥称举报人的解释缺乏说服力，法庭因此不采纳她的证言。他裁定吴无罪，并判给他法律费用。在香港，非礼罪一旦定罪，最高可判处 10 年监禁。

reflection.en: This story draws attention to justice, dignity, and accountability. Micah 6:8 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with justice tempered by mercy, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到公义、尊严与问责。Micah 6:8提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以带着怜悯的公义来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: FS stresses Hong Kong-Singapore cooperation
title.zh: 财政司强调香港新加坡合作

summary.en: Financial Secretary Paul Chan acknowledged the longstanding rivalry between Hong Kong and Singapore but emphasized that their shared future depends on increased collaboration. He spoke at the Singapore National Day Dinner, highlighting the cities' common traits of resilience and adaptability, and proposed a spirit of...
summary.zh: 财政司陈茂波承认香港和新加坡之间长期存在竞争，但强调他们共同的未来取决于更深入的合作。他在新加坡国庆晚宴上发表讲话，强调了这两个城市长期以来共同的特质：韧性、敏捷性和快速适应能力。他提议，双方应“在必要时竞争，在最重要的地方合作”，并以这种“合作竞争”的精神，各自发挥最大潜力，为区域做出贡献。

body.en: Financial Secretary Paul Chan acknowledged the longstanding rivalry between Hong Kong and Singapore, but insisted their shared future hinges on deeper collaboration. Speaking at the Singapore National Day Dinner on Friday, Chan highlighted the common traits that have long defined both cities: resilience, agility, and an uncanny ability to adapt at speed. "We should compete where we must, and co-operate where it matters most. Some describe this as 'co-opetition'. Whatever the term, it is in this spirit that our two cities will each realise our full potential, and that our partnership will contribute most to the region," he said. To underscore the depth of their economic ties, Chan pointed to substantial cross-investments with Singapore’s holdings in Hong Kong standing at HK$310 billion, while the SAR’s stake in the Lion City is at around HK$340 billion. These figures, he said, are proof of a relationship built on solid ground. Looking ahead, he proposed that the two financial hubs pool their strengths to amplify the region’s global clout – particularly in shaping standards for emerging sectors like green finance and artificial intelligence governance. Edited by Edmond Fong
body.zh: 财政司司长陈茂波承认香港和新加坡之间长期存在竞争，但坚称它们的共同未来取决于更深层次的合作。周五在新加坡国庆晚宴上发表讲话时，陈强调了长期以来定义这两个城市的共同特征：韧性、敏捷性和不可思议的快速适应能力。他说：“我们应该在必要的地方竞争，在最重要的地方合作。有些人将其描述为‘合作竞争’。无论用什么术语，正是本着这种精神，我们两个城市将充分发挥我们的潜力，我们的伙伴关系将为该地区做出最大贡献。”为了强调两国经济联系的深度，陈指出，新加坡在香港的持股金额高达 3,100 亿港元，而香港特区在狮城的持股金额约为 3,400 亿港元。他说，这些数字证明了两国关系建立在坚实的基础上。展望未来，他建议这两个金融中心汇集优势，扩大该地区的全球影响力，特别是在制定绿色金融和人工智能治理等新兴行业的标准方面。埃德蒙·方编辑

reflection.en: In the complex dance between competition and cooperation, leaders often seek a path that maximizes mutual benefit. Financial Secretary Paul Chan's vision for Hong Kong and Singapore to embrace 'co-opetition' suggests a pragmatic approach to shared challenges and opportunities. This echoes the wisdom of committing one's endeavors to divine guidance, trusting...
reflection.zh: 在竞争与合作的复杂博弈中，领导者常常寻求最大化互惠互利的途径。财政司陈茂波提出的香港与新加坡拥抱“合作竞争”的愿景，为共同的挑战和机遇提供了一种务实的策略。这与凡事交托雅伟，信靠祂的指引必得成功的智慧相呼应。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Unmanned electric aircraft makes maiden flight in Hong Kong
title.zh: 香港首次试飞无人电动飞机

summary.en: An unmanned electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft completed its first demonstration flight in Hong Kong on Friday. This event is part of the city's initiative to foster a low-altitude economy, with the government targeting the completion of relevant legislation by 2027. The flight was a collaborative...
summary.zh: 一架无人电动垂直起降（eVTOL）飞机于周五在香港进行了首次演示飞行。此举是该市推动低空经济发展的一部分，政府目标是在2027年前完成相关立法。此次飞行是内地自动驾驶航空器公司亿航、本地交通运营商冠忠巴士集团以及香港科技枢纽数码港之间合作的成果。

body.en: An unmanned electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft made its maiden demonstration flight in Hong Kong on Friday, as the city pushes to develop a low-altitude economy, with the government aiming to complete drafting relevant legislation by 2027. The flight marked a collaboration between mainland Chinese autonomous aerial vehicle firm EHang, local transport operator Kwoon Chung Bus Holdings and the city’s technology hub, Cyberport. The flight took place at Cyberport in Pok Fu...
body.zh: 随着香港大力发展低空经济，政府计划在 2027 年完成相关立法的起草工作，一架无人驾驶电动垂直起降 (eVTOL) 飞机周五在香港进行了首次演示飞行。这次飞行标志着中国大陆自动驾驶飞行器公司亿航、当地交通运营商冠忠巴士控股公司和香港科技中心数码港之间的合作。该航班在薄扶数码港进行...

reflection.en: The successful maiden flight of an unmanned electric aircraft in Hong Kong represents a significant step in technological advancement and economic development. It is a testament to human ingenuity and collaborative effort. As this new venture takes flight, may its creators and operators commit their work to Yahweh, seeking His wisdom and guidance for...
reflection.zh: 香港无人电动飞机的成功首飞，标志着技术进步和经济发展的重要一步。这是人类智慧和协作努力的证明。随着这项新事业的起飞，愿其创造者和运营者将他们的工作交托给雅伟，寻求祂在创新和负责任发展方面的智慧与指引。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Evening News on TV32 - Aug 28
title.zh: TV32 晚间新闻 - 8月28日

summary.en: Top stories for Friday, Aug 28, 2026 - Rescuers continue their search for survivors of deadly floods and landslides along the China-Nepal border. - The MTRC adopts a state-of-the-art construction method in building Hung Shui Kiu station. - Firms have been invited to apply for...
summary.zh: 2026年8月28日星期五主要新闻 - 救援人员继续在中国-尼泊尔边境搜寻致命洪水和山体滑坡的幸存者。 - 地铁公司在建造洪水桥站时采用了最先进的施工方法。 - 已邀请公司申请...

reflection.en: The news of deadly floods and landslides along the China-Nepal border brings to mind the immediate suffering of those affected. In the face of such devastation, the work of rescuers embodies the call to overcome evil with good, offering hope and aid where disaster has struck. May Yahweh strengthen those who bring relief and comfort to the afflicted.
reflection.zh: 中国-尼泊尔边境发生的致命洪水和山体滑坡的消息，让人联想到受灾者的即时痛苦。面对如此的毁灭，救援人员的工作体现了以善胜恶的呼召，在灾难发生的地方带来希望和援助。愿雅伟赐予那些向受苦者伸出援手和安慰的人力量。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Uber, Didi say preparing to apply for ride-hailing service licence as gov’t invites submissions
title.zh: 优步、滴滴表示正准备申请网约车服务牌照，政府已开放申请

summary.en: Ride-hailing services Uber and Didi have said they are preparing to apply for licences under a new scheme opened by the government on Friday, an effort to regulate the fast-growing industry.
summary.zh: 网约车服务公司优步（Uber）和滴滴出行（Didi）表示，它们正准备根据政府周五启动的新计划申请牌照，该计划旨在规范快速发展的行业。

body.en: Ride-hailing services Uber and Didi have said they are preparing to apply for licences under a new scheme opened by the government on Friday, an effort to regulate the fast-growing industry. The Uber app. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. In response to HKPF, Uber said on Friday: “We are preparing our application for a ride-hailing platform license with a firm commitment to delivering a safe, high-quality experience for passengers and strong support for driver-partners and the Hong Kong Government.” Uber’s reply came as the government opened applications for ride-hailing licences on Friday morning. This follows the passage of a bill last October that introduced laws intended to regulate the sector under a licencing regime. Under the new regime, all ride-hailing platforms must hold a licence to operate in Hong Kong. Ride-hailing drivers must must also hold a specific licence, which is due to be issued from November. Applications to sit the written test for this licence opened earlier this month . Operators applying for a platform licence must have a permanent office in Hong Kong and experience offering services in a city with a comparably large population, and must also provide evidence the company’s financial capacity. Ride-hailing app Didi. Photo: Rhoda Kwan/HKFP. In addition to US-based Uber, mainland China’s Didi has also indicated it will apply. Didi told local media that it welcomed the authorities’ announcement of the application details, and added that the clear criteria introduced by the government is imperative for the regulatory framework’s success. The company said it would submit its application “as soon as possible.” HKFP has reached out to Didi for comment. New legislation Ride-hailing platforms have grown rapidly in recent years by offering convenient services amid mounting public frustration directed at Hong Kong’s conventional taxi fleet. Uber first entered the local market in 2014, followed by Didi in 2018. But ride-hailing vehicles have since operated in a legal grey area with no dedicated legislation. The city’s taxi industry has long accused ride-hailing platforms of impacting cab drivers’ livelihoods . For years, they have pushed the government to introduce a mechanism regulating ride-hailing operators. Vehicles in Hong Kong. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The ride-hailing licence applications opened on Friday are a core part of the government’s long-awaited regulatory efforts. From next August, when the regulatory regime comes into full force, operators of ride-hailing platforms that do not have a licence will face a maximum fine of HK$1 million and up to a year in prison. Drivers convicted of carrying passengers for hire or reward without a permit will be disqualified from...
body.zh: 叫车服务优步和滴滴表示，他们正准备根据政府周五启动的一项新计划申请牌照，以规范这个快速增长的行业。优步应用程序。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。优步周五在回应香港警务处时表示：“我们正在准备申请网约车平台牌照，坚定承诺为乘客提供安全、优质的体验，并为司机合作伙伴和香港政府提供大力支持。”周五上午，政府开放打车牌照申请后，优步做出了回应。此前，去年 10 月通过了一项法案，该法案引入了旨在根据许可制度监管该行业的法律。根据新制度，所有网约车平台必须持有香港运营牌照。网约车司机还必须持有特定许可证，该许可证将于 11 月起颁发。参加该许可证笔试的申请已于本月初开放。申请平台牌照的运营商必须在香港拥有常设办事处，并具有在人口较多的城市提供服务的经验，还必须提供公司的财务能力证明。打车应用滴滴。照片：Rhoda Kwan/HKFP。除了美国的Uber外，中国大陆的滴滴出行也表示将申请。滴滴向当地媒体表示，欢迎当局公布申请细节，并补充说，政府出台的明确标准对于监管框架的成功至关重要。该公司表示将“尽快”提交申请。 HKFP 已联系滴滴征求意见。新立法近年来，随着公众对香港传统出租车队的不满情绪日益浓厚，网约车平台通过提供便捷的服务而迅速发展。优步于 2014 年首次进入当地市场，滴滴也于 2018 年进入。但此后，网约车一直处于法律灰色地带，没有专门的立法。该市的出租车行业长期以来一直指责叫车平台影响出租车司机的生计。多年来，他们一直推动政府引入监管网约车运营商的机制。香港的车辆。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。周五开放的网约车牌照申请是政府期待已久的监管工作的核心部分。从明年8月起，监管制度全面生效，无牌照的网约车平台运营商将面临最高100万港元的罚款和最高一年的监禁。未经许可载客或取酬而被定罪的司机将被取消资格...

reflection.en: As ride-hailing giants Uber and Didi prepare to apply for licenses under Hong Kong's new regulatory scheme, their actions reflect a commitment to operating within established civic structures. This willingness to submit to governing authorities, as outlined in Romans 13:1, is vital for a stable society and for businesses to contribute to the common good. It...
reflection.zh: 随着网约车巨头优步和滴滴准备根据香港新的监管计划申请牌照，它们的行动体现了在既定公民框架内运营的承诺。这种顺服执政掌权者的意愿，正如《罗马书》13:1所阐明的，对于社会稳定和企业为共同利益做出贡献至关重要。它提醒我们，即使在一个快速发展的行业中，与政府负责任的互动也能确保所有公民的安全和优质服务。

verse.textEn: Let everyone be subject to the governing authorities, for there is no authority except that which God has established.
verse.textZh: 在上有权柄的，人人当顺服他，因为没有权柄不是出于神的。

title.en: Tai Po fire: 96.5% of Wang Fuk Court homeowners agree to gov’t buyback scheme as 70 remain undecided
title.zh: 大埔火灾：王福庭业主96.5%同意政府回购计划，仍有70人未决定

summary.en: Over 96% of homeowners at the fire-damaged Wang Fuk Court have accepted the government's buyback offer for their flats, with the scheme deadline approaching. Secretary for Housing Winnie Ho reported that 1,914 out of 1,984 owners had agreed, leaving 70 undecided just days before the offer expires.
summary.zh: 在火灾后的王福庭，超过96%的业主已接受政府的回购提议，而该计划的截止日期临近。房屋局局长何永贤报告称，在1984名业主中已有1914人同意，仅剩70人在最后期限前仍未做出决定。

body.en: More than 96 per cent of homeowners at the fire-hit Wang Fuk Court have agreed to sell their flats to the government under an official buyback scheme that is due to expire next Monday, a senior official has said. Wang Fuk Court on May 4, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Secretary for Housing Winnie Ho said on Friday that, as of Thursday, 1,914 of the estate’s 1,984 owners – or 96.5 per cent – had signed and returned a letter of acceptance regarding the government’s buyback offer. That means 70 owners remained undecided, with only a few days remaining before the deadline on Monday at 5pm. “There are a little over three days left from today, and we encourage these owners to seize the opportunity to sign and return the letter of acceptance before 5pm Monday,” Ho wrote in a Chinese-language Facebook post. In an emailed reply to HKFP on Friday, the government said 1,526 homeowners – 76.9 per cent of the total – have also taken the next step in the process, signing a formal sale and purchase agreement. The government announced the buyback scheme in February, after a blaze tore through seven residential towers at Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po on November 26 last year, killing 168 people and displacing thousands at the government-subsidised estate. Prices have been set at HK$8,000 or HK$10,500 per square foot, depending on whether the homeowner has paid land premiums. Owners can choose to receive cash or swap their flat for a new government-subsidised unit under a special sales scheme. Around 4,400 government-subsidised flats have been reserved for those who opt in for the scheme. Flat selection to begin Sept Ho said on Friday that the government would use a computerised lottery to determine when homeowners who opt in to the flat swap can select their new units, with priority given to owners who returned their acceptance letters before June 30. Hong Kong Secretary for Housing Winnie Ho addresses the Legislative Council on January 14, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Starting from the end of September, arrangements will be made for between 50 and 80 households daily to select a new flat, Ho added. She also said that the 10 estates included in the scheme are spread across the city, and include about 2,800 units with a saleable area exceeding 400 square feet. Deputy Financial Secretary Michael Wong has said that authorities may acquire unsold property titles through “legislative means.” Some Wang Fuk Court residents have said they felt they had no choice but to accept the government’s buyback offer after authorities said they would not rebuild the fire-hit estate on its original site.
body.zh: 一名高级官员表示，受火灾影响的宏福苑超过 96% 的房主已同意根据一项将于下周一到期的官方回购计划将其公寓出售给政府。宏福苑，2026 年 5 月 4 日。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。房屋局局长何温妮周五表示，截至周四，该庄园 1,984 名业主中的 1,914 名业主（即 96.5%）已签署并返回有关政府回购提议的接受书。这意味着 70 名业主尚未做出决定，距离周一下午 5 点的截止日期仅剩几天时间。何先生在脸书中文版帖子中写道：“距离今天还有三天多一点的时间，我们鼓励这些业主抓住机会，在周一下午 5 点之前签署并返回接受函。”在周五给 HKFP 的电子邮件回复中，政府表示，1,526 名房主（占总数的 76.9%）也已采取下一步行动，签署了正式的买卖协议。去年11月26日，大埔宏福苑发生大火，烧毁了七栋住宅楼，造成168人死亡，并导致该政府资助庄园内的数千人流离失所，之后，政府于2月宣布了回购计划。价格定为每平方尺8,000港元或10,500港元，视乎业主是否缴付地价而定。业主可以选择获得现金或根据特别销售计划将其单位换成政府补贴的新单位。约4,400个政府资助单位已预留给选择参与该计划的人士。开始选楼 何九周五表示，政府将使用电脑抽签来决定选择换屋的业主何时可以挑选新单位，并优先考虑在 6 月 30 日之前寄回录取通知书的业主。香港房屋局局长何温妮于 2026 年 1 月 14 日在立法会发表讲话。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。 Ho补充说，从9月底开始，每天将安排50至80户家庭选择新单位。她又表示，计划涵盖的10个屋村遍布全港，包括约2,800个单位，实用面积超过400平方尺。财政副司长黄伟纶表示，当局可能会通过“立法手段”收购未售出的房产。宏福苑的一些居民表示，在当局表示不会在原址重建遭受火灾的屋苑后，他们别无选择，只能接受政府的回购提议。

reflection.en: The government's buyback scheme for the fire-affected Wang Fuk Court homeowners demonstrates a commitment to alleviating hardship. Jeremiah 22:3 calls leaders to "execute justice and righteousness, and deliver from the hand of the oppressor him who suffers violence." This initiative, while not strictly about oppression, reflects a governmental...
reflection.zh: 政府为受火灾影响的王福庭业主提供的回购计划，体现了缓解困境的承诺。耶利米书22:3呼吁领导者“施行公平和公义，拯救被欺压的脱离欺压者的手。”这项举措虽然不直接涉及压迫，但反映了政府在危机时刻照顾其人民的责任。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Man nabbed after over 4k litres of illicit fuel seized
title.zh: 香港仔检获逾四千公升私油，一名男子被捕

summary.en: Authorities in Aberdeen arrested a driver and seized approximately 4,150 litres of suspected illicit fuel worth HK$136,000. The operation, involving police and customs, uncovered a syndicate using sampans and rafts to store the untaxed fuel.
summary.zh: 当局在香港仔逮捕了一名司机，并检获约4,150公升疑似私油，市值约13.6万港元。警方、海关及消防处联合行动，揭发一个有黑社会背景的集团利用舢舨和浮排储存这些未完税燃料。

body.en: A light goods vehicle driver has been arrested after authorities seized about 4,150 litres of suspected illicit fuel in Aberdeen. Authorities also seized the vehicle and a sampan in a cross-departmental operation held by police, customs, and the Fire Services Department that took place on Thursday. The suspected illicit fuel that was untaxed had an estimated market value of HK$136,000. Police senior inspector Kwan Ka-ki said a syndicate with triad background had allegedly used sampans and rafts to store suspected illicit fuel at the Aberdeen Typhoon Shelter. Officers found about 1,800 litres of suspected illicit fuel on the vehicle parked nearby and 84 barrels of suspected illicit fuel in the sampan. “Following in-depth investigation and intelligence analysis, police found that the syndicate made use of vehicles to transport illicit fuel from other places to the Aberdeen Wholesale Fish Market area, then used speedboats to transport them to the typhoon shelter,” she said. “They then used specific vessels parked at the shelter as mobile fuel storage to illegally store a large amount of illicit fuel.” The probe also showed that the illicit fuel was used to supply vessels involved in smuggling activities, Kwan said. Senior station officer Yeung Chun-wa from the Fire Services Department said the 34-year-old arrestee will be prosecuted for allegedly violating the Dangerous Goods Ordinance and Dangerous Goods (Control) Regulation. “There are residential estates near the site. In case of fire or explosion, it could lead to massive injuries and casualties, and significant financial losses,” he said. Authorities did not rule out further arrests. Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 当局在阿伯丁查获约 4,150 升可疑非法燃油后，逮捕了一名轻型货车司机。周四，警方、海关和消防处进行了跨部门行动，当局还扣押了这辆车和一艘舢舨。未征税的怀疑非法燃油估计市值为港币136,000元。警方高级督察关嘉基表示，一个具有三合会背景的犯罪团伙涉嫌利用舢舨和木筏在香港仔避风塘储存可疑非法燃料。警方在附近停放的车辆上发现约1,800公升疑似非法燃油，并在舢舨内发现84桶疑似非法燃油。她说：“警方经过深入调查和情报分析，发现该集团利用车辆从外地运送非法燃油至香港仔鱼品批发市场一带，再利用快艇运送至避风塘。” “然后他们利用停泊在避难所的特定船只作为移动燃料储存库，非法储存大量非法燃料。”关说，调查还显示非法燃料被用来向参与走私活动的船只供应。消防处高级警署人员杨俊华表示，34岁被捕者将因涉嫌违反《危险品条例》及《危险品（管制）规例》而被检控。 “现场附近有住宅小区，一旦发生火灾或爆炸，可能会造成重大人员伤亡和重大经济损失。”他说。当局不排除进一步逮捕的可能性。谭咏麟编辑

reflection.en: The discovery of thousands of litres of illicit fuel in Aberdeen reminds us that hidden shortcuts often lead to a dead end. While the pursuit of profit can tempt people toward deception, true prosperity is built on the foundation of honesty and shared responsibility. Integrity in our dealings, even in the 'unseen' parts of the economy, reflects a heart that...
reflection.zh: 在香港仔发现数千公升私油提醒我们，隐藏的捷径往往通向死胡同。虽然对利润的追求可能诱使人们走向欺骗，但真正的繁荣是建立在诚实和共同责任的基础之上的。我们在交易中的正直，即使是在经济中“看不见”的部分，也反映了一颗尊重雅伟公义标准的心。

verse.textEn: Yahweh detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.
verse.textZh: 诡诈的天平为雅伟所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。

title.en: The London stock market dodged a bullet with Shein | Nils Pratley
title.zh: 伦敦股市避开了 Shein 这颗“子弹”

summary.en: Shein, the Chinese fast-fashion giant, is set to list in Hong Kong with a reduced valuation after a potential London IPO stalled. Despite intense wooing by UK politicians seeking to revitalize the local market with 'tech adrenalin,' significant concerns regarding Shein's business model and ethical practices led to a...
summary.zh: 中国快时尚巨头 Shein 在伦敦上市计划搁置后，将转往香港上市，但估值有所缩水。尽管英国政界此前为了振兴当地市场而积极拉拢，希望注入“技术兴奋剂”，但由于对其商业模式和伦理实践存在重大疑虑，伦敦金融界对于未能成事反而感到一种解脱。

body.en: China’s fashion giant will list in Hong Kong with a shrunken price tag – and big questions over its business model In a parallel world, we might now be preparing for the arrival on the London stock market of Shein, the giant Chinese-founded fast-fashion retailer. Or it could have happened already. The possibility of a London flotation was a running story during 2024 and into last year as politicians from both main parties engaged in behind-the-scenes wooing. Shein was seen as a shot of tech adrenalin for a listless local listings scene, and an opportunity to advertise the UK’s openness to international capital. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中国时尚巨头将以更低的价格在香港上市——其商业模式面临重大质疑在另一个平行世界中，我们现在可能正在为中国创办的大型快时尚零售商 Shein 登陆伦敦股市做准备。或者它可能已经发生了。从 2024 年到去年，随着两大主要政党的政治家都在幕后拉拢，在伦敦上市的可能性一直是一个热门话题。 Shein 被视为为当地无精打采的上市场景注入一剂科技肾上腺素，也是宣传英国对国际资本开放的机会。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The pursuit of rapid economic growth often tempts leaders to overlook the long-term health and ethical foundations of their institutions. While the 'tech adrenalin' of a massive IPO is attractive, true prudence involves recognizing when a short-term gain carries risks that outweigh the benefits. Yahweh values the wisdom that looks beyond the surface of a...
reflection.zh: 对经济快速增长的追求往往诱使领导者忽视机构的长期健康和伦理基础。虽然大规模 IPO 带来的“技术兴奋剂”极具吸引力，但真正的谨慎在于识别短期利益何时携带了超过收益的风险。雅伟看重那种能看透“缩水的价格标签”表面、审视内在工作诚信的智慧。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: The Guardian view on the Tiananmen vigil convictions: Hong Kong too has been silenced. Others should speak out | Editorial
title.zh: 《卫报》评论天安门守夜活动定罪：香港也被噤声。其他人应发声 | 社论

summary.en: Two activists in Hong Kong face jail sentences for organizing commemorations of the 1989 Tiananmen Square crackdown. For decades, Hong Kong was the only place in China where the annual vigil could publicly keep the memory of the pro-democracy protests alive, but recent crackdowns have suppressed these freedoms.
summary.zh: 两名香港社运人士因组织纪念1989年天安门镇压的活动而面临牢狱之灾。几十年来，香港是中国唯一可以公开纪念天安门民主抗议活动的地方，但最近的镇压已经扼杀了这些自由。

body.en: Two activists who organised commemorations of the bloody crackdown on China’s 1989 pro-democracy protests now face jail. Remembering is not a crime For decades, Hong Kong mourned when the mainland could not. Its huge annual Tiananmen vigil kept alive the memory of the 1989 pro-reform protests in Beijing, and of the massacre that suppressed them. Along with Macau, it was the only place in China where the anniversary could be publicly marked and the truth preserved. But the crackdown on the 2019 uprising in Hong Kong has crushed the freedoms that the region once enjoyed. That year’s vigil was the last. On Friday, two leaders of the Hong Kong Alliance, which organised the commemoration, were convicted of incitement to subversion under the draconian national security law. Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, and Chow Hang-tung, 41, face up to 10 years in jail. Do you have an opinion on the issues raised in this article? If you would like to submit a response of up to 300 words by email to be considered for publication in our letters section, please click here . Continue reading...
body.zh: 两名组织纪念中国 1989 年血腥镇压民主抗议活动的活动人士现在面临牢狱之灾。铭记不是犯罪 几十年来，香港一直在哀悼，而大陆却无法铭记。一年一度的天安门守夜活动让人们牢牢记住了1989年北京支持改革的抗议活动以及镇压抗议活动的大屠杀。它与澳门一样，是中国唯一可以公开纪念这一周年并保存真相的地方。但2019年香港起义的镇压摧毁了该地区曾经享有的自由。那一年的守夜活动是最后一次。周五，组织这次纪念活动的香港联盟的两名领导人根据严厉的国家安全法被判犯有煽动颠覆罪。 69 岁的李卓人和 41 岁的周恒东将面临最高 10 年的监禁。您对本文提出的问题有什么看法吗？如果您想通过电子邮件提交最多 300 字的回复，以便考虑在我们的信件部分发布，请单击此处。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The conviction of two Hong Kong activists for organizing a Tiananmen vigil highlights the silencing of memory and dissent. Proverbs 31:8 calls us to "speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves," a principle embodied by those who sought to keep the truth of 1989 alive. As freedoms are crushed in Hong Kong, this story reminds us of the moral...
reflection.zh: 两名香港社运人士因组织天安门守夜活动而被定罪，这凸显了记忆和异议被压制的情况。箴言31:8呼吁我们“为不能自辩的人开口”，这正是那些努力让1989年真相得以存留的人所体现的原则。随着香港自由的被扼杀，这个故事提醒我们，其他人有道德义务为那些被噤声的人发声。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Science & Nature Desk
title.zh: 自然科学

strap.en: Discoveries in nature, climate, health, and the wider cosmos.
strap.zh: 自然、气候、健康与宇宙万象的新发现。

title.en: Climate policy could learn from people who already live within the limits of sufficiency
title.zh: 气候政策可借鉴已生活在充裕限度内的人们

summary.en: Tina Nyfors, who recently defended her doctoral thesis at the University of Helsinki, studied sufficiency, a way of living and a principle for organizing society to stay within environmental limits while ensuring that people have enough. Nyfors directs attention to people whose carbon footprint is already in line with...
summary.zh: 赫尔辛基大学博士生蒂娜·尼福斯（Tina Nyfors）研究了“充裕”（sufficiency）——一种既能保持在环境限度内，又能确保人们拥有足够的生活方式和组织社会原则。尼福斯特别关注那些碳足迹已符合充裕标准的人，称他们为“充裕阶层”。他们的生活方式对气候影响适中，同时仍能满足他们的需求。

body.en: Tina Nyfors, who recently defended her doctoral thesis at the University of Helsinki, studied sufficiency, a way of living and a principle for organizing society to stay within environmental limits while ensuring that people have enough. Nyfors directs attention to people whose carbon footprint is already in line with sufficiency and refers to them as the sufficiency class. Their way of life has a moderate climate impact yet still meets their needs.
body.zh: 蒂娜·尼福斯 (Tina Nyfors) 最近在赫尔辛基大学进行了博士论文答辩，她研究了充足性、一种生活方式以及组织社会在确保人们拥有充足资源的同时保持在环境限制范围内的原则。 Nyfors 将注意力集中在碳足迹已经达到充足水平的人群，并将他们称为充足类别。他们的生活方式对气候影响不大，但仍能满足他们的需求。

reflection.en: The Psalmist marvels at the diversity and wisdom woven into creation, declaring, 'How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all.' Dr. Nyfors’ research into 'sufficiency' echoes this, finding ways of living that respect ecological limits while meeting human needs. It suggests that observing and learning from the patterns already present in...
reflection.zh: 诗篇作者惊叹于受造界中交织的多元性和智慧，宣告说：“雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！万物都凭你的智慧造了。” 尼福斯博士对“充裕”的研究与此不谋而合，它发现了既尊重生态限制又能满足人类需求的生活方式。这表明，观察并学习受造界中已有的模式，以及那些与受造界和谐相处之人的生活，可以为社会组织提供深刻的见解。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: The discovery of the Great Barrier Reef's whale maternity ward
title.zh: 大堡礁鲸鱼产房的发现

summary.en: What began with a simple call to action 17 years ago has resulted in the Whitsundays region establishing world-class protection for migrating humpback whales. Tourism operators' observations of unusual whale behavior in 2009 led to scientific inquiry, culminating in this significant discovery.
summary.zh: 17年前，一个简单的行动呼吁开启了惠特桑迪地区为迁徙的座头鲸建立世界一流保护的历程。2009年，旅游经营者观察到座头鲸的异常行为，引发了科学研究，最终促成了这一重要发现。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

It started with a simple message: "This is the year to do something small for something huge." Now, 17 years later, the Whitsundays region has some of the best protection in the world for migrating humpback whales.

Sightings of unusual humpback whale behavior began to mount in 2009 as tourism operators in the Whitsundays reported observations of 'fluking' to the Reef Authority's Eye on the Reef network. Perplexed by what they were seeing, they reached out to scientists to understand the behavior.

What followed was a major research effort that ultimately led to the discovery of a globally important whale calving area in the Whitsundays.

Master Reef Guides Program Manager Crystal Lacey said the operators were reporting sightings of a behavior known as 'fluking,' in which whales float upside down with their tails raised above the water's surface.

"It was an unusual behavior they had never seen before. Not even the whale scientists knew what it meant at the time. So that uncertainty sparked a major research effort, which combined citizen science through the tourism operators' observations and scientific research.

"It was one of the region's largest citizen science efforts, recording whale sightings and calves through Eye on the Reef. Just in that one year, there were 780 adults and 153 calves sighted in the Whitsundays."

While tourism operators counted whales and calves, scientists mapped the seafloor, monitored water temperatures, tracked whales by satellite and surveyed the region from the air. Together, they gathered evidence that revealed the Whitsundays as one of the Great Barrier Reef's most important humpback whale calving areas.

"We discovered the Whitsundays provide the sheltered, warm and shallow waters humpback whales need to give birth and raise newborn calves."

The breakthrough solved one of the biggest mysteries surrounding humpback whales on the Great Barrier Reef—where they give birth. The discovery subsequently led to the establishment of the Whitsundays Whale Protection Area, where cetaceans are given higher levels of protection than in any other area of the Marine Park.

The Whale Protection Area strengthens the region's plan of management by setting rules for how people interact with whales. These include minimum approach distances for vessels and aircraft and a ban on swimming with whales. Breaches of these regulations are enforceable by law.

As well as helping establish the Whale Protection Area, tourism operators played a major role in the region achieving a Whale Heritage Area designation in 2024. Together with Whitsunday community members,...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 它以一条简单的信息开头：“今年是小事成就大事的一年。” 17 年后的今天，圣灵群岛地区为座头鲸迁徙提供了世界上最好的保护。 2009 年，随着圣灵群岛的旅游经营者向珊瑚礁管理局的珊瑚礁网络之眼报告了“侥幸”的观察结果，座头鲸异常行为的目击事件开始增多。他们对所看到的感到困惑，于是联系科学家来了解这种行为。 随后进行的一项重大研究工作最终导致在圣灵群岛发现了全球重要的鲸鱼产仔区。 珊瑚礁主向导项目经理克里斯托·莱西 (Crystal Lacey) 表示，运营商报告称看到了一种被称为“侥幸”的行为，即鲸鱼倒立漂浮，尾巴伸出水面。 “这是他们以前从未见过的不寻常行为。当时就连鲸鱼科学家也不知道这意味着什么。因此，这种不确定性引发了一项重大研究工作，将公民科学通过旅游经营者的观察和科学研究结合起来。 “这是该地区最大的公民科学活动之一，通过“珊瑚礁之眼”记录鲸鱼和幼鲸的目击事件。仅在那一年，就有 780 只成年鲸和 153 只幼鲸在圣灵群岛被发现。” 当旅游经营者计算鲸鱼和幼鲸的数量时，科学家们则绘制海底地图、监测水温、通过卫星追踪鲸鱼并从空中勘察该地区。他们共同收集了证据，证明圣灵群岛是大堡礁最重要的座头鲸产仔区之一。 “我们发现圣灵群岛为座头鲸提供了生育和抚养新生幼鲸所需的庇护、温暖和浅水区。” 这一突破解决了有关大堡礁座头鲸产卵的最大谜团之一。这一发现随后导致了圣灵群岛鲸鱼保护区的建立，这里的鲸目动物受到比海洋公园任何其他区域更高水平的保护。 鲸鱼保护区通过制定人们与鲸鱼互动的规则来加强该地区的管理计划。其中包括船只和飞机的最小接近距离以及禁止与鲸鱼一起游泳。违反这些规定将受到法律制裁。 除了帮助建立鲸鱼保护区外，旅游运营商还为该地区在 2024 年获得鲸鱼遗产区的称号发挥了重要作用。与圣灵群岛社区成员一起，...

reflection.en: The discovery of the Whitsundays as a crucial nursery for humpback whales is a testament to the intricate wonders of creation. It reminds us that Yahweh's world is filled with marvelous life, and that careful observation and dedicated effort can reveal and protect these vital ecosystems. May we continue to marvel at the diversity of life and commit to...
reflection.zh: 惠特桑迪地区被发现是座头鲸重要的繁殖地，这证明了造物中精妙的奇迹。它提醒我们，雅伟的世界充满了奇妙的生命，细致的观察和不懈的努力能够揭示并保护这些至关重要的生态系统。 愿我们继续惊叹于生命的 |多样性，并致力于保护自然世界，认识到雅伟作品中固有的深邃智慧和美丽。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Galápagos corals show El Niño events are more extreme now than in past 1,000 years
title.zh: 加拉帕戈斯珊瑚显示：厄尔尼诺现象比过去1000年更极端

summary.en: Temperatures in the equatorial Pacific have warmed dramatically in 2026, signaling a potentially historic El Niño. Data from Galápagos corals indicates that recent events are becoming more intense and destructive compared to the last millennium of climate history.
summary.zh: 2026年赤道太平洋气温剧烈上升，预示着一场可能具有历史意义的强厄尔尼诺现象的到来。来自加拉帕戈斯群岛的珊瑚数据显示，与过去一千年的气候历史相比，近期的厄尔尼诺事件正变得更加剧烈且具破坏性。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Temperatures have warmed dramatically across the equatorial Pacific Ocean in 2026, signaling the onset of a strong and potentially historic El Niño . These events can affect weather around the world, and the intensity of recent El Niño events is raising alarm that, as global temperatures rise , they are becoming stronger and more destructive .

To understand how these climate patterns are changing, we need to understand what happened during El Niño events in the past, but observations go back only a few decades. So, my colleagues and I went to the Galápagos Islands—at the heart of the El Niño pattern—to find answers from some of nature's best record keepers: corals.

In records preserved by living and ancient fossil corals, we found that, on average, El Niño events have been stronger in the past 40 years than at any time in the past millennium, with higher temperatures that lead to more powerful effects on weather.

Our results, just published in the journal Science , suggest that the 1982–83 and 1997–98 El Niños—two of the strongest in recent memory—may be harbingers of more extreme events to come as the planet warms.

One of the strongest El Niños hit in 1982, with devastating consequences for the Galápagos Islands. It triggered a marine heat wave that reverberated through one of the most distinctive and unspoiled ecosystems on the planet.

Exceptionally warm surface water blocked the usual upwelling of cool, nutrient-rich water that fuels the food chain for marine life . The result ravaged communities that rely on the ocean —fish, birds, marine mammals and people who fish for their livelihoods throughout the eastern tropical Pacific. In the extraordinary heat, more than 95% of Galápagos corals died .

The heat wave was caused by an exceptionally strong El Niño event, part of a climate pattern that begins in the eastern tropical Pacific Ocean, around the Galápagos Islands, as the trade winds shift. El Niño's warm ocean water alters the atmospheric circulation above, diverting storm tracks and changing patterns of floods, droughts and tropical storms around the globe.

The 1982–83 El Niño contributed to climate extremes worldwide, from flooding in Kenya and Peru to drought in Indonesia and Brazil, costing the global economy as much as US$4 trillion by some estimates. A similarly strong El Niño in 1997–98 resulted in 23,000 deaths from disease and climate disasters.

But we wanted to know: Are such powerful El Niño events unusual in the context of history?

Even in 1983, scientists were surprised to find that such a strong event had been underway. Historical records of...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 2026 年，赤道太平洋气温急剧升高，预示着强烈且可能具有历史意义的厄尔尼诺现象即将到来。这些事件会影响世界各地的天气，最近厄尔尼诺事件的强度引起了人们的警觉，随着全球气温上升，它们变得更强、更具破坏性。 为了了解这些气候模式是如何变化的，我们需要了解过去厄尔尼诺事件期间发生了什么，但观测只能追溯到几十年前。因此，我和我的同事前往位于厄尔尼诺现象中心的加拉帕戈斯群岛，从一些自然界最好的记录保持者：珊瑚那里寻找答案。 在现存和古代珊瑚化石保存的记录中，我们发现，平均而言，过去 40 年的厄尔尼诺事件比过去千年中的任何时候都要强烈，气温升高对天气的影响也更大。 我们的研究结果刚刚发表在《科学》杂志上，表明 1982-83 年和 1997-98 年的厄尔尼诺现象——近期记忆中最强的两次厄尔尼诺现象——可能是随着地球变暖而出现更多极端事件的预兆。 1982 年，最强的厄尔尼诺现象之一袭来，给加拉帕戈斯群岛带来了毁灭性的后果。它引发了海洋热浪，波及地球上最独特且未受破坏的生态系统之一。 异常温暖的地表水阻碍了凉爽、营养丰富的水通常的上涌，而这些水为海洋生物的食物链提供了燃料。结果破坏了依赖海洋的社区——鱼类、鸟类、海洋哺乳动物以及整个东热带太平洋地区以捕鱼为生的人们。在异常炎热的天气下，超过 95% 的加拉帕戈斯珊瑚死亡。 热浪是由异常强烈的厄尔尼诺事件引起的，这是随着信风转变而始于加拉帕戈斯群岛周围热带太平洋东部的气候模式的一部分。厄尔尼诺现象的温暖海水改变了上方的大气环流，改变了风暴路径，改变了全球洪水、干旱和热带风暴的模式。 1982-83 年的厄尔尼诺现象导致了全球范围内的极端气候，从肯尼亚和秘鲁的洪水到印度尼西亚和巴西的干旱，据估计，全球经济损失高达 4 万亿美元。 1997-98 年同样强烈的厄尔尼诺现象导致 23,000 人死于疾病和气候灾难。 但我们想知道：如此强大的厄尔尼诺事件在历史背景下是否不寻常？ 即使在 1983 年，科学家们也惊讶地发现如此强烈的事件已经发生。历史记载有...

reflection.en: The silent testimony of Galápagos corals provides a thousand-year perspective on our changing world, revealing a planet under increasing thermal stress. By "asking" these ancient organisms, scientists uncover the sobering reality of how human-driven changes are pushing natural cycles to their breaking point. As we listen to the witness of creation, we are...
reflection.zh: 加拉帕戈斯珊瑚的无声见证为我们观察不断变化的世界提供了一个千年的视角，揭示了地球正承受着日益严重的温热压力。通过“询问”这些古老的生物，科学家们揭示了一个令人警醒的现实：人类驱动的变化正将自然循环推向崩溃的边缘。当我们倾听受造物的见证时，我们被提醒要对雅伟委托我们管理的这套脆弱系统负起责任。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Earlier swathing opens a new pathway for subterranean clover seed harvest
title.zh: 提前刈割为地下三叶草种子收获开辟新途径

summary.en: Subterranean clover's ability to bury its seed supports pasture persistence but makes commercial seed harvesting difficult. The industry relies on aging Horwood-Bagshaw (HB) suction harvesters, which collect seed from fully dry crops after repeated tillage and raking.
summary.zh: 地下三叶草将种子埋入地下的能力有助于牧草的持久性，但也使得商业种子收割变得困难。该行业目前依赖老旧的Horwood-Bagshaw (HB) 吸力收割机，这些机器在多次耕作和耙地后，从完全干燥的作物中收集种子。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Subterranean clover's ability to bury its seed supports pasture persistence but makes commercial seed harvesting difficult. The industry relies on aging Horwood-Bagshaw (HB) suction harvesters, which collect seed from fully dry crops after repeated tillage and raking.

Two experimental studies investigated a very different approach: cutting and lifting plants with modified peanut-harvesting equipment while they are still green, then drying them in windrows for later collection and threshing.

The research demonstrates that viable seed can be recovered well before complete crop desiccation, creating a potential pathway toward harvesting with fewer machinery passes and less soil disturbance.

A commercial-scale trial at Capel, Western Australia, compared swathing a subterranean clover seed crop on Nov. 25 and Dec. 1, 2022, with conventional HB harvesting in February 2023.

A modified peanut digger cut the roots below ground, lifted the plants and placed them in windrows with the burrs attached, representing the first stage of a proposed two-stage system. Seed was collected from the windrows by hand because the second stage, mechanical pickup and threshing, was not tested.

The equipment successfully lifted and windrowed the crop, although soil attached to the plants and weeds became tangled in the machinery. These issues indicate that substantial equipment refinement and changes to paddock and harvest management would be needed.

The most important finding was that subterranean clover could be harvested while plants still retained green material. Potential seed yield did not differ among the two swathing dates and the much later HB harvest, indicating that maximum seed yield had largely been reached before the crop was completely dry.

Swathing on Nov. 25 moved almost 100% of the available seed into the windrow. This fell to 84.2% on Dec. 1 as the crop became more senescent but remained higher than the 61.3% recovered by a single HB pass following three preparatory tillage operations.

The earliest harvested seed was lighter and had lower and more variable germination. However, seed swathed on Dec. 1 achieved 98.0% germination, comparable with 97.5% for seed harvested by the HB in February. Seedlings that emerged from the earlier-harvested seed generally showed similar vigor to those produced by later-harvested seed.

These results suggest there is a harvest window in which plants remain intact enough to retain their burrs while the seed has developed sufficiently to maintain yield and quality.

Supporting research examined changes in burr attachment and harvest loss...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 地下三叶草埋藏种子的能力支持了牧场的持久性，但使商业种子收获变得困难。该行业依赖老化的 Horwood-Bagshaw (HB) 吸力收割机，该收割机在反复耕作和耙地后从完全干燥的作物中收集种子。 两项实验研究调查了一种截然不同的方法：用改良的花生收获设备在植物还是绿色的时候切割和提升植物，然后将它们放在料堆中干燥以供以后收集和脱粒。 研究表明，在作物完全干燥之前，可以很好地回收有活力的种子，从而创造了一条以更少的机械通过和更少的土壤扰动进行收获的潜在途径。 在西澳大利亚卡佩尔进行的一项商业规模试验，将 2022 年 11 月 25 日和 12 月 1 日收获的地下三叶草种子作物与 2023 年 2 月的传统 HB 收获进行了比较。 改良的花生挖掘机将根部切入地下，将植物举起，并将它们放入带有毛刺的料堆中，这代表了拟议的两阶段系统的第一阶段。种子是手工从料堆中收集的，因为第二阶段（机械拾取和脱粒）没有经过测试。 尽管植物上附着的土壤和杂草被机械缠住，但该设备成功地举升并堆放了农作物。这些问题表明需要对设备进行大量改进并改变围场和收获管理。 最重要的发现是，地下三叶草可以在植物仍然保留绿色物质的情况下被收获。两个收割日期和较晚的 HB 收获期之间的潜在种子产量没有差异，这表明在作物完全干燥之前已基本达到最大种子产量。 11 月 25 日的收割将几乎 100% 的可用种子转移到料堆中。 12 月 1 日，由于作物变得更加衰老，这一数字下降至 84.2%，但仍高于 3 次预备耕作操作后单次 HB 通行恢复的 61.3%。 最早收获的种子较轻，发芽率较低且变化较大。然而，12 月 1 日包埋的种子发芽率为 98.0%，而 HB 2 月份收获的种子发芽率为 97.5%。从较早收获的种子中长出的幼苗通常表现出与较晚收获的种子产生的幼苗相似的活力。 这些结果表明存在一个收获窗口，在该窗口中植物保持足够完整以保留其毛刺，同时种子已充分发育以保持产量和质量。 支持研究检查了毛刺附着和收获损失的变化...

This pursuit of a 'new pathway' through experimental studies reflects a discerning heart that acquires knowledge, striving to improve agricultural practices. title.en: How the weather in space can affect us on Earth - and the team trying to protect us
title.zh: 太空天气如何影响地球：致力于保护我们的科研团队

summary.en: The Met Office and Aberystwyth University are collaborating to monitor solar flares and space weather, which can disrupt essential technologies like GPS and power grids. A dedicated team operates 24/7 to provide forecasts that help protect Earth's infrastructure from these cosmic disturbances.
summary.zh: 英国气象局与阿伯里斯特威斯大学正合作监测太阳耀斑和太空天气，这些现象可能会干扰全球定位系统（GPS）和电网等关键技术。一个专门的团队全天候运作，提供预报以保护地球基础设施免受这些宇宙干扰的影响。

body.en:
At the Met Office headquarters, the screens in one corner of the control centre are focussed on close up imagery of the Sun.

It is here that a space weather prediction team, one of only a small number worldwide, operates 24-hours a day, 365 days a year.

The weather in space has the potential to impact our lives here on Earth in a fundamental way. GPS, power grids and satellites are some of the vital technologies vulnerable to changes in the earth's magnetic field.

As a result, the Met Office has turned to Aberystwyth University researchers to help them improve their space weather forecasting abilities.

Space weather is mostly driven by activity on the Sun. Examples include solar flares, which are intense bursts of radiation.

The UK government has included severe space weather in its National Risk Register.

A 2025 estimate by Lloyds , external found that a severe space weather event could cost the world economy 2.4 trillion dollars ($2,400,000,000,000) over a five year period.

The Met Office has been working with key infrastructure operators since 2014 to try to keep us safe from those impacts, by producing forecasts using equipment on earth and satellites out in space.

Richard Stone, from the space forecasting team, said it allowed them "to diagnose anything that's happening on the Sun's surface, provide a forecast and alert the relevant users to be able to take mitigating actions".

Stone said the available technology was incredibly impressive, but still at an early stage.

"We've made great strides since 2014, but observations are still limited," he said.

Despite spotting an event on the Sun's surface around three days before it reaches Earth, there are no more sightings until it reaches satellites about one million miles away.

This gives scientists around one hour to more precisely predict its real effect on Earth and, if needed, warn partners of the mitigation needed to avoid disruption.

"It's like seeing a storm on the east coast of America and then not having any observations until it gets to Ireland," said Stone.

The agency has turned to a group of researchers, led by Aberystwyth University, to improve its forecasting abilities.

The project is being led by Professor Huw Morgan, who is Head of Space Physics at Aberystwyth University, working alongside Northumbria, Durham and Reading universities.

"This pre-warning is a huge mitigation of the danger posed by space weather," said Morgan.

"For example, it gives the National Grid an opportunity to prepare and avoid power cuts, or airlines can divert their flights from high latitude to safer lower latitudes.

"Compared to forecasting normal weather on Earth, space weather forecasting is really quite a developing field. I mean, it's yet to mature where we can give exact...
body.zh: 在英国气象局总部，控制中心一角的屏幕集中显示太阳的特写图像。 正是在这里，一个太空天气预报团队每年 365 天、每天 24 小时不间断地工作，是全球仅有的少数几个团队之一。 太空天气有可能从根本上影响我们在地球上的生活。 GPS、电网和卫星是一些容易受到地球磁场变化影响的重要技术。 因此，英国气象局求助于阿伯里斯特威斯大学的研究人员，帮助他们提高太空天气预报能力。 太空天气主要是由太阳活动驱动的。例子包括太阳耀斑，它是强烈的辐射爆发。 英国政府已将恶劣的太空天气纳入其国家风险登记册。 劳埃德银行 (Lloyds) 对 2025 年的预测显示，严重的太空天气事件可能会在五年内给世界经济造成 2.4 万亿美元（2,400,000,000,000 美元）的损失。 自 2014 年以来，英国气象局一直与主要基础设施运营商合作，通过使用地球上的设备和太空卫星进行预测，努力保护我们免受这些影响。 太空预测团队的理查德·斯通表示，这使他们能够“诊断太阳表面发生的任何情况，提供预测并提醒相关用户采取缓解措施”。 斯通表示，现有技术令人印象深刻，但仍处于早期阶段。 “自 2014 年以来，我们取得了长足进步，但观察结果仍然有限，”他说。 尽管在太阳到达地球前三天左右在太阳表面发现了一个事件，但直到它到达大约一百万英里外的卫星之前，没有更多的目击事件。 这让科学家们大约有一小时的时间来更准确地预测其对地球的实际影响，并在需要时警告合作伙伴需要采取哪些缓解措施以避免破坏。 “这就像在美国东海岸看到一场风暴，然后直到它到达爱尔兰才进行任何观测，”斯通说。 该机构已向阿伯里斯特威斯大学领导的一组研究人员寻求帮助，以提高其预测能力。 该项目由阿伯里斯特威斯大学空间物理学系主任休·摩根教授领导，与诺森比亚大学、达勒姆大学和雷丁大学合作。 摩根说：“这一预警极大地减轻了太空天气造成的危险。” “例如，它使国家电网有机会做好准备并避免断电，或者航空公司可以将航班从高纬度地区转移到更安全的低纬度地区。 “与预测地球上的正常天气相比，太空天气预报确实是一个相当发展的领域。我的意思是，它还没有成熟，我们可以给出准确的......

reflection.en: While we often focus on the weather at our feet, this collaboration reminds us that our modern life depends on the invisible stability of the heavens. By studying solar flares and magnetic fields, these researchers exercise a form of stewardship that anticipates risks before they strike. It is a reminder that Yahweh has given us the capacity to observe the...
reflection.zh: 虽然我们通常只关注地面的天气，但这项合作提醒我们，现代生活依赖于诸天之上那看不见的稳定性。通过研究太阳耀斑和磁场，这些研究人员履行了一种管家的职责，在风险发生前进行预判。这提醒我们，雅伟赋予了我们观察天空征兆的能力，以保护我们每天赖以生存的脆弱系统。

title.en: Diverse portfolio of protected areas key to Mexican conservation efforts
title.zh: 多样化的保护区组合对墨西哥保护工作至关重要

summary.en: In 2020, Mexico joined 150 nations committing to protect 30% of its territory by 2030 as part of the global 30x30 initiative. More than halfway through the decade, there is ongoing debate about how to effectively expand protected areas to meet that ambitious goal.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

In 2020, Mexico joined 150 nations committing to protect 30% of its territory by 2030 as part of the global 30x30 initiative. More than halfway through the decade, there is ongoing debate about how to effectively expand protected areas to meet that ambitious goal.

Mapping the overlap between the country's current network of protected land and the habitat of 28 terrestrial carnivores, ecologists at the Yale School of the Environment found that 16% of habitat is covered by legally designated conservation areas. The percentage overlap is lower when considering threatened and endangered species specifically, according to the study published in Conservation Science and Practice .

The overlap balloons to 39%, though, when the researchers expanded their analysis to include wildlife management units and Indigenous territories—land management types that do not officially count toward Mexico's biodiversity goals but clearly have a role to play in conservation, the authors say. That finding highlights the need for a diverse mosaic of conservation areas to protect carnivores.

"We're getting close to 2030, so if we're going to meet the 30x30 targets, we need a strategy. We need to be deliberate about what counts and what is actually working," said study author Nyeema Harris, the Knobloch Family Association Professor of Wildlife and Land Conservation. "This analysis allows us to take that first step to assess the portfolio we have, figure out what's missing and decide where to focus our attention."

Protected areas have long been a cornerstone of conservation and have played an important role in minimizing habitat loss. Yet, there is growing recognition of the ways different communities rely on natural resources and interest in "multiple-use areas" that are geared toward human-wildlife coexistence.

This growing awareness motivated the researchers to be more inclusive about what land "counts" in their analysis, Harris said. They decided to examine four types of conservation areas, including formal protected areas such as national parks and Indigenous territories that are demarcated more by culture than any particular land use.

They then mapped where managed land intersects with carnivore habitat to both assess the current network of conservation areas and identify priorities for expanding it. They focused specifically on carnivores—including South America's iconic apex predator, the jaguar—due to their significant ecological, social and economic value.

"If you include community-managed areas, they have a different governance structure, audience and scale, and their objectives...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 2020 年，墨西哥与 150 个国家一起承诺到 2030 年保护其 30% 的领土，作为全球 30x30 倡议的一部分。十年多过去了，关于如何有效扩大保护区以实现这一雄心勃勃的目标的争论一直在持续。 耶鲁大学环境学院的生态学家绘制了该国目前的保护区网络与 28 种陆地食肉动物栖息地之间的重叠部分，发现 16% 的栖息地被法定保护区覆盖。根据《保护科学与实践》上发表的研究，在具体考虑受威胁和濒危物种时，重叠百分比较低。 作者表示，当研究人员将分析范围扩大到野生动物管理单位和土著领地（虽然不正式计入墨西哥的生物多样性目标，但显然在保护方面发挥作用的土地管理类型）时，重叠率激增至 39%。这一发现凸显了需要建立多样化的保护区来保护食肉动物。 “我们已经接近 2030 年，所以如果我们要实现 30x30 的目标，我们需要一个策略。我们需要仔细考虑什么是重要的，什么是真正有效的，”研究作者、诺布洛赫家族协会野生动物和土地保护教授尼玛·哈里斯 (Nyeema Harris) 说。 “这项分析使我们能够迈出第一步来评估我们拥有的投资组合，找出缺少的内容并决定将我们的注意力集中在哪里。” 保护区长期以来一直是保护的基石，并在最大限度地减少栖息地丧失方面发挥着重要作用。然而，人们越来越认识到不同社区依赖自然资源的方式以及对旨在实现人类与野生动物共存的“多用途区域”的兴趣。 哈里斯说，这种日益增强的意识促使研究人员在分析中更加包容地看待土地“重要”的内容。他们决定研究四种类型的保护区，包括国家公园和原住民领地等正式保护区，这些保护区更多地是通过文化而不是任何特定的土地用途来划分的。 然后，他们绘制了管理土地与食肉动物栖息地相交的位置图，以评估当前的保护区网络并确定扩大该网络的优先事项。他们特别关注食肉动物，包括南美标志性的顶级掠食者美洲虎，因为它们具有重要的生态、社会和经济价值。 “如果包括社区管理的区域，它们会有不同的治理结构、受众和规模以及目标......
